patients.title: Three-vessel phenotype, clean multimodal data
patients.expect: All gates pass; wearable heart rate replaces the record value

patients.title: Normal coronaries, clean multimodal data
patients.expect: All gates pass; low vessel probabilities

patients.title: Watch last synced 6 hours ago
patients.expect: Wearable rejected as STALE; pulse rate falls back to the FHIR record

patients.title: Exercise session with ectopic beats
patients.expect: Wearable degraded: motion samples excluded, HRV rejected (RR_ARTIFACT)

patients.title: Stream from a device not registered to this patient
patients.expect: Wearable rejected (DEVICE_UNBOUND): wrong-patient data never reaches the model

patients.title: Labs and echo older than three years
patients.expect: Risk withheld: INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY after stale records are excluded
